text:
Nitrogen monoxide, NO, and carbon monoxide, CO, are both removed from the exhaust gases of
a car by a catalytic converter.
Which statement describes how nitrogen monoxide and carbon monoxide are removed by a
catalytic converter?
A
Nitrogen monoxide and carbon monoxide are both reduced.
B
Nitrogen monoxide and carbon monoxide are both oxidised.
C
Nitrogen monoxide is oxidised and carbon monoxide is reduced.
D
Nitrogen monoxide is reduced and carbon monoxide is oxidised.

options.label: A
options.text: Nitrogen monoxide and carbon monoxide are both reduced.

options.label: B
options.text: Nitrogen monoxide and carbon monoxide are both oxidised.

options.label: C
options.text: Nitrogen monoxide is oxidised and carbon monoxide is reduced.

options.label: D
options.text: Nitrogen monoxide is reduced and carbon monoxide is oxidised.
